create_Lifter_3d_voxel_grid: create a Lifter module to lift 2D image features into a 3D voxel grid with configurable head type
run_Lifter_forward: run the Lifter forward pass on a batch to produce voxel features, counts, and world positions
build_Lifter_with_cnn_head: build a Lifter with a CNN upsampling head to upsample 2D features before lifting to 3D
test_Lifter_lift_aggregate: test the lift_aggregate_centers method to project voxel centers into images and aggregate sampled features
review_Lifter_get_voxelgrid_pose: review the get_voxelgrid_pose method that computes gravity-aligned voxel grid pose from camera poses
